newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta slides vs mark as French futures weaken.
newsitem.headline: Peseta slides vs mark as French futures weaken.

text.p: Despite renewed dollar strength, the peseta weakened versus the mark on Wednesday as French shares plunged on talk that privately commissioned polls showed the opposition Socialists in the lead before Sunday's vote.
"This is the most normal behaviour before the second round on Sunday," said Alfredo Urrutia, chief economist at Societe Generale in Madrid.
AT 1130 GMT, the peseta was trading at 84.53/55 per mark after an early 84.33/38 as the dollar traded above 1.70 marks.
The French CAC-40 was down 92.78 points, or 3.46 percent, to 2,586.85 amid worries for the final election following the unexpected defeat for the centre-right in the first round.
